'''William Stephen Childress''' is an American applied mathematician, author and professor emeritus at the [[Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences]]. He works on classical fluid mechanics, asymptotic methods and singular perturbations, geophysical fluid dynamics,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2012/11/121112171221.htm|title=Erosion has a point, and an edge|website=ScienceDaily|access-date=2022-06-25|archive-date=2020-11-12|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201112023626/https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2012/11/121112171221.htm|url-status=live}}</ref> magnetohydrodynamics and dynamo theory, mathematical models in biology,<ref> {{Cite web |url=https://scienmag.com/how-do-birds-breathe-better-researchers-discovery-will-throw-you-for-a-loop/|title=How do birds breathe better? Researchers' discovery will throw you for a loop|work=SCIENMAG: Latest Science and Health News |date=16 March 2021 }}</ref> and locomotion in fluids.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.abc.net.au/science/articles/2014/01/15/3925459.htm|title='Jellyfish' flying machine keeps upright|first=15 January 2014 Anna SallehABC|last=Wednesday|date=January 15, 2014|website=www.abc.net.au|access-date=25 June 2022|archive-date=9 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200809110811/https://www.abc.net.au/science/articles/2014/01/15/3925459.htm|url-status=live}}</ref> He is also a co-founder of the Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences's Applied Mathematics Lab.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Applied Math Lab - People |url=https://math.nyu.edu/aml/wetlab/People.html |website=math.nyu.edu |access-date=2022-06-27 |archive-date=2021-05-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210515060017/https://math.nyu.edu/aml/wetlab/People.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

* 1977: Mechanics of Swimming and Flying, online {{ISBN|9780511569593}}.<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/mechanics-of-swimming-and-flying/BC307741E1F6A377F6DDD850421FF1CA|title=Mechanics of Swimming and Flying|first=Stephen|last=Childress|date=June 25, 1981|publisher=Cambridge University Press|doi=10.1017/CBO9780511569593 |isbn=9780521236133 |access-date=June 25, 2022|archive-date=January 30, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220130021718/https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/mechanics-of-swimming-and-flying/BC307741E1F6A377F6DDD850421FF1CA|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 1978: Mathematical models in developmental biology  with Jerome K. Percus, {{ISBN|978-1470410803}}
* 1987: Topics in Geophysical Fluid Dynamics: Atmospheric Dynamics, Dynamo Theory, and Climate Dynamics, with M. Ghil. Softcover {{ISBN|978-0-387-96475-1}}, eBook {{ISBN|978-1-4612-1052-8}}.<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-1-4612-1052-8|title=Topics in Geophysical Fluid Dynamics: Atmospheric Dynamics, Dynamo Theory, and Climate Dynamics|series=Applied Mathematical Sciences |year=1987 |volume=60 |via=link.springer.com|doi=10.1007/978-1-4612-1052-8|isbn=978-0-387-96475-1 |access-date=2022-06-25|archive-date=2022-01-30|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220130125339/https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007%2F978-1-4612-1052-8|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 1995: Stretch, Twist, Fold: The Fast Dynamo with Andrew D. Gilbert, {{ISBN|978-3662140147}},  {{ISBN|3662140144}}
* 2009: An Introduction to Theoretical Fluid Mechanics, {{ISBN|978-0-8218-4888-3}}.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ams.org/publications/authors/books/postpub/cln-19|title=Childress: An Introduction to Theoretical Fluid Mechanics|website=American Mathematical Society|access-date=2022-06-25|archive-date=2021-01-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210127021708/http://www.ams.org/publications/authors/books/postpub/cln-19|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 2012: Natural Locomotion in Fluids and on Surfaces Swimming, Flying, and Sliding. Edited with [[Anette Hosoi]], William W. Schultz, [[Z. Jane Wang|Jane Wang]]. Hardcover {{ISBN|978-1-4614-3996-7}}, Softcover {{ISBN|978-1-4899-9916-0}}, eBook {{ISBN|978-1-4614-3997-4}}<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-1-4614-3997-4|title=Natural Locomotion in Fluids and on Surfaces|series=The IMA Volumes in Mathematics and its Applications |year=2012 |volume=155 |via=link.springer.com|doi=10.1007/978-1-4614-3997-4|isbn=978-1-4614-3996-7 |access-date=2022-06-25|archive-date=2022-03-03|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220303144750/https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-1-4614-3997-4|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 2018: Construction of Steady-state Hydrodynamic Dynamos. I. Spatially Periodic Fields, {{ISBN|978-1378904725}}
